steps.what: Observe readings and establish attendance and operating context
Transcribe source values onto specified operational forms
Check discrepancies and sign the completed operational record

tasks.design: Configure rounds and form mappings in the {OPS_SYSTEM}; use {OTHER}, the plant historian, for already recorded instrument values. The operator captures unsensed readings and attendance once, and checks the populated record before signing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field notes and specified forms require the same values to be entered twice.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital rounds and historian links support one capture followed by fixed field mappings.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible reading can still be wrong, and attendance needs a reliable observation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise abnormal plant conditions and challenge misleading instrument values.
tasks.altitude: Less transcription leaves more time for inspecting plant conditions; operating authority is unchanged.

reach.learn: Instrument identifiers, calibration status and fault reporting

evidence.claim: AVEVA Mobile Operator rounds feed the historian; the BASF Antwerp account reports 650,000 readings in a year but no labour saving.
Removing duplicate entry while retaining capture and verification is a task-specific scenario, not measured water-treatment performance.

assumptions: Boundary is operator capture, transcription and final verification; physical rounds and attendance observation remain counted in s1.

The plant operator in s1 produces asset or person identifier, timestamp, value or attendance status, unit, source and exception note. Capturing and correcting these fields remains in the full 35 hours; sensor values come from existing historian tags whose time, unit and quality the operator checks there.
Native forms map those fields in s2; unknown tags, units or attendance states return to manual recording within the retained capture and discrepancy time. Do not launch if this exceeds the allowance.
Test native rounds, form mappings and historian exports before custom integration. Existing sensor runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Whether readings are already recorded once
Accepted attendance source and access rights
Share of forms supported by native mappings
research_questions: Does a parallel shift trial remove transcription without increasing capture or discrepancy time?

incremental.description: Maintain tag mappings, form versions and attendance exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact populated form version, source values, units, timestamps and resolved exceptions; any change voids signature

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100, R=60, gross=40%, less 4 focal upkeep gives 36% central net. Low assumes only 14 transcription hours removable with the same capture and upkeep; already digital single-entry plants have no such gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct routine plant operations and maintenance

steps.what: Establish plant conditions and maintenance priorities
Direct plant workers and confirm safe work sequencing
Coordinate progress and revise assignments when conditions change

tasks.design: Keep plant coordination with the operator using the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} and direct conversations. Assignments depend on current conditions, worker competence and safe access; no additional scheduling tool is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Work sequencing depends on physical conditions and discussions rather than a complete scheduling dataset.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing status and work-order screens already support the human decision.
tasks.still_hard: Plans change during maintenance and workers may identify hazards absent from records.
tasks.human_edge: Balance treatment continuity, safe work and the team's actual capabilities.
tasks.altitude: The operator retains the same coordination responsibilities and decision rights.

reach.learn: Permit boundaries, isolation dependencies and crew competence

evidence.claim: Routine operational coordination remains dependent on plant context and worker communication; no saving is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary includes the focal operator's status review, directions and follow-up; workers' actual maintenance is outside this task denominator.
No new structured producer, automated decision or software deployment is introduced. Existing work-order and plant-status producers retain their present arrangements.
Native status views are used as they stand. No incremental configuration or maintenance is added, so ongoing new work is zero.
unknowns: Local permit authority and worker competence records
research_questions: Are coordination delays caused by missing information or physical access constraints?

already_counted.description: Plant review, worker direction and progress coordination

incremental.description: No new system or process to maintain

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving are zero, with no incremental upkeep. No communication or safety judgement is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Remove duplicate form entry where it exists while retaining control-room and field decisions.
reach: Work with maintenance technicians on unreliable instruments
role.ambitious_version: An operator who spends less time copying readings and more time understanding abnormal plant behaviour.

job.title: Water and Wastewater Treatment Plant and System Operators
